GProj2D89 1.0.1 validation report
==================================

Requested code change
---------------------
PASS - shotgun hull is emitted by gp2d_add_box as a four-point rectangle
PASS - shotgun hull default fill is red (214, 42, 42, 255)
PASS - shotgun base is emitted by gp2d_add_box as a four-point rectangle
PASS - shotgun base default fill is yellow (255, 211, 48, 255)
PASS - buckshot and slug profiles share the modified shell generator
PASS - primer remains an independent role/path
PASS - outline and recolor controls remain active

Compiler checks
---------------
PASS - GCC strict C89: -std=c89 -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -Werror
PASS - GCC 32-bit core object: -m32
PASS - Clang strict C89
PASS - core object has no undefined external symbols

Runtime tests
-------------
PASS - all nine profiles are exposed by the catalog
PASS - every projectile profile generates paths and points
PASS - every supported shell generates paths and points
PASS - every complete icon validates
PASS - shotgun block geometry and default colors are asserted
PASS - outline enable/disable works
PASS - fill override works
PASS - role recolor API works
PASS - caller capacity errors are bounded and reported
PASS - Q16.16 multiplication regression test

Static restrictions audit
-------------------------
PASS - no dynamic allocator calls in include/src
PASS - no floating numeric types in include/src
PASS - no C++ line comments in include/src

Preview generation
------------------
PASS - SVG generated from the actual modified library API
PASS - 118 vector paths
PASS - 1302 points
PASS - PNG rasterized at 1600 x 1080

Measured artifacts
------------------
Optimized 64-bit GCC core object: 38,832 bytes
Optimized 32-bit GCC core object: 25,708 bytes
Optimized 64-bit Clang core object: 33,880 bytes
Preview PNG: 141,013 bytes
Preview SVG: 43,620 bytes
